turns.situation: The study door has just come down under the hall poker, the household is crowding the first-floor gallery, and a key has been heard to hit the carpet inside; the Major is first over the threshold, pockets the key 'for safekeeping,' and orders you down to count the plate while the doctor is called to the desk and the valet holds the maids back at the stairhead.
turns.what_you_must_do: Get a clear look at the study before the Major shuts the door on it: the keyhole you put your eye to a minute ago with the lamp visible through it, the frozen window, the ash in the grate, the poker in its stand, and the yellow tallow stub snuffed in the mantel candlestick where only white wax belongs.
involves: the master's valet of forty years
turns.set_piece: the study door broken down with a poker, the household crowding the threshold, and the key heard to fall onto the carpet

turns.situation: Dinner is laid for seven with the master's chair empty and the storm against the dining-room windows; the Major holds the table on the overheard quarrel and announces he will carry the household's sworn account to the magistrate at the thaw, while the fiancée, as you set her place, asks you under her breath whether the sherry glass has been washed yet.
turns.what_you_must_do: Serve the whole dinner without the Major getting the lipstick-marked glass or the fiancée's ten o'clock visit out of you, and get from her, between courses, what hour she really left the study and what the master's lamp and fire looked like when she did, before the nephew bolts from the table for the yard.
turns.set_piece: seven places laid at dinner with the master's chair empty, the storm at the windows, and no one willing to be the first to eat

turns.situation: It is past midnight; the nephew has been dragged back half-frozen from the stables and locked in his room with the valet set in a chair at his door, the Major has sent you to bed, and the first-floor gallery is dark except for the one candle you carry.
turns.what_you_must_do: Walk your rounds of the murder night again with the candle, counting the seconds between each door to fix the true hour of the quarrel against the ward's eleven o'clock, and get the valet, who will not leave the nephew's door, to give you at least the hour at which he drew a tallow candle from your box and lit someone up the back stairs.
involves: the master's valet of forty years
turns.set_piece: the housekeeper alone at night re-walking the first-floor corridor with a candle, counting the seconds between each door

turns.situation: The eaves are dripping at dawn, the lodge-keeper has waded up to say the road will carry a cart by noon, and the Major has ordered the carriage and sent two maids up to the study with pails and a fresh scuttle to clear the grate and relight the fire, with the doctor waiting to have the body carried out to the ice house.
turns.what_you_must_do: Get into the study with the maids under the Major's eye and come out with the tallow stub, the shape of the keyhole and the poker's weight in your hand before the grate is raked and the carpet swept, and make the doctor say, within your hearing, that the master knew he was dying and had sent for his oldest friend.

turns.situation: The house is gathered in the drawing room before the fire with the carriage at the door; the Major has called for your account of the night to be read aloud so the seven may sign it and the nephew be taken down the road to the magistrate within the hour.
turns.what_you_must_do: Give your account in your own order, lay the tallow stub and the keyhole and the hour of the quarrel before the room, bring the valet to say to the Major's face whom he lit up the back stairs at eleven, and then speak the killer's name to that person across the fire, whether it is the Major, the nephew, the fiancée, the widow, the doctor, the solicitor or the ward, and hold the room to it until the carriage is sent for the right passenger.
involves: the master's valet of forty years
turns.set_piece: the drawing room at the moment the name is spoken, every face turning, and one of them going still

complications.description: REVERSAL: after you corner the valet on the back stairs, he goes not to you but to the Major, and at breakfast the Major announces to the house that the valet has confirmed lighting 'the young gentleman' up to the study at eleven; the valet, asked to deny it, says nothing, and the hour you dragged out of him now stands as the strongest plank in the case against the nephew.

The fiancée, frightened that the glass has not been washed, tells the Major that the new housekeeper has been pocketing things from the study; on the heir's word your room is searched, the tallow stub and your written timeline are taken into the Major's keeping, and you are told you will give your account from memory alone unless you can get them back before the drawing room.
